item.description:
**⌘B brings the SFTP window back.** It used to do nothing whenever the host list was not the front window — including from the SFTP window itself and from Settings, which is exactly when you would reach for it. Bringing a browser you already have forward no longer needs the host list in front. Opening a *new* one still does, because that needs the host list the window holds.
Nothing else is visible from the outside. The rest of this release is groundwork: the rules behind the tab strip, Quick Connect's ranking, the group tree and the host store have been lifted into places that can be checked without driving the window, and the suite went from 254 checks to 315 — the first of them to reach above the engine. Three cycle guards, against a group becoming its own ancestor, had never been exercised until now.
The Release build compiles without a warning again, which is mostly worth saying because that is where a real one would otherwise hide.

Nothing in the app has changed since 0.0.1.
This release exists to exercise updating itself. 0.0.1 shipped with the machinery — Sparkle, a signed feed, a notarized DMG — but a first release has nothing to update *from*, so none of it could be proven. 0.0.2 is the first version an installed copy can actually find, download, verify and install, and these notes are the first ever carried inside the feed.
If you are reading this in Shellhand's own update window, every part of it worked.
